photos.title: Streets of houses in The Parks of Carolina Forest, NOAA aerial, January 2026
photos.what: Three curving streets of one- and two-story houses with short driveways and small fenced back yards, in phases 3 and 4 of The Parks of Carolina Forest, seen straight down from above on January 12, 2026. A four-lane road runs along the top behind a strip of pine woods; woods and a pond edge along the bottom. Lawns are brown in January. Cars are too small to read; no person can be recognized.
photos.caption: Houses in The Parks of Carolina Forest, seen from above.
photos.alt: Rows of similar houses with gray roofs, short driveways and small fenced back yards along curving streets in Carolina Forest, seen from above

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-02. The frame shows streets of houses with fenced back yards in The Parks of Carolina Forest (ZIP 29579 area, Carolina Forest). It does not show which houses are rentals, for sale, or have 3 bedrooms, so the caption says only that these are houses in Carolina Forest, the area of the page's example sheet. No person, plate, sign or house number is legible.
